info.title: Foodsharing Hackathon API
info.description:
## Foodsharing Hackathon API

This API manages team users, simulated verification, food baskets, pickup requests,
Fairteiler locations, fictional businesses and completed pickups for the Frankfurt Sustainability Hackathon.

### Authentication and users

Protected endpoints require a team key in `X-API-Key`. Swagger's **Authorize**
accepts the key without a prefix. Each team has two test users.

`GET /users` lists the team's users. For user-specific actions, `X-User-ID`
selects a member of that team; each request without it uses the key's default user.
Routes with a user ID in the path target that ID and ignore `X-User-ID`.

User profiles, verification and personal histories are scoped to the authenticated
team. Baskets and their request summaries are readable with any valid team key.
Changing a request requires the selected user to be its requester or basket owner,
depending on the target status.

Public endpoints: Fairteiler list and detail, `/`, `/ready`, `/docs`, `/redoc`
and `/openapi.json`.

### Verification and pickups

| Source | Pickup permission |
|---|---|
| Baskets and Fairteiler | All team users; no verification or quiz required |
| Businesses | Only verified users (`is_verified: true`) |

`POST /pickups` records baskets/Fairteiler. `GET /businesses` lists fictional shops;
`POST /businesses/{business_id}/pickups` records a business rescue for the selected user.
Each successful business POST creates a separate event; no appointment slots or stock
are simulated. Unverified business requests receive 403 with their verification state.
`may_pick_up` covers baskets/Fairteiler; `may_pick_up_from_business` covers businesses.

Regular verification requires a passed quiz, enough trial pickups and approval.
The default trial threshold is three and is returned as `trial_pickups_required`
in verification data. `POST /users/me/approve` records simulated approval,
including before quiz or trials are complete. Introductory pickups are simulated via
`PATCH /users/{user_id}/verification` with `trial_pickups_completed`; collecting baskets
or Fairteiler food does not advance this onboarding step.

GET /users returns the current state of both test users, including any trial credit.
Test PATCHes can edit flags, counters and timestamps. An explicit `is_verified`
takes precedence in that PATCH. Later verification input PATCHes or approval
recalculate it. Counter edits preserve event history. All new rescues increment the
regular pickup counter and have `was_trial: false`; historical trial records are preserved.

`GET /users/me` includes verification data. `GET/PATCH /users/{user_id}/verification`
returns that state directly. A verification denial on a business pickup
includes `detail.error`, `detail.message` and `detail.verification`.

### Pickup data

| Endpoint | Content |
|---|---|
| `GET /users/me/pickups` | Selected user's history with pickup `id` |
| `GET /pickups/sample` | Non-team history with `person` instead of pickup `id` |

Both contain the source, `picked_up_at`, `was_trial`, source coordinates and
basket, Fairteiler or business details. Sample pseudonyms remain stable across pages and filters
while the non-team user set is unchanged. All team members are excluded from the sample.

The API contains no points, badges or leaderboard. The existing `may_earn_rewards`
field equals `is_verified`; it does not calculate or grant rewards.
Example locations are in Frankfurt am Main; new baskets can use any valid latitude
and longitude. Basket expiry is a technical availability deadline.

get.description:
Stored Fairteiler and Abgabestelle locations, with name and coordinates. Location data covers the Frankfurt am Main area.

Call it without parameters to get the full list, or pass `lat` **and** `lon` to get only the ones nearby, sorted by distance.

This endpoint requires no API key.

patch.summary: Freely edit a team member's verification steps
patch.description: Freely set or reset quiz_passed, trial_pickups_completed, mentor_approved, is_verified and their timestamps for sandbox testing. Omitted inputs are preserved; derived verification and timestamps may change automatically. Changed quiz/approval flags automatically set or clear their timestamps unless an explicit timestamp is provided. Supplying quiz, approval or trial counter inputs recalculates verification even when their values are unchanged; explicit is_verified takes precedence for this PATCH. Later onboarding changes recalculate verification again. Counter edits preserve actual pickup history. Names, regular pickup counters, IDs and team membership are not editable here. Use Authorize in Swagger to enter your team's X-API-Key. Other teams' users return 404.

post.description:
Records that you picked something up, either from a Fairteiler (`food_share_point_id`) or from a basket (`basket_id`) — exactly one of the two.

No verification required: all team users may collect baskets and Fairteiler food. New pickups have was_trial: false and increment the regular counter, never trial credit. Business rescues use POST /businesses/{business_id}/pickups and require verification. Each successful Fairteiler POST creates another event.

An unexpired, free basket may be picked up directly. Your own baskets are rejected (400); expired, completed or other users' reserved baskets return 409. An existing open request of yours is completed with the same pickup. Closed requests cannot be reopened.

patch.description:
Only the two people involved may change a request, and which of them depends on the new status:

| Status | Who may set it |
|--------|----------------|
| `accepted`, `rejected` | the user who **offered** the basket |
| `cancelled` | the **requester**, withdrawing their own request |
| `picked_up` | **either** party |

Setting the status to `picked_up` records a Pickup for the requester — that is an event in their `GET /users/me/pickups` history.

Only pending or accepted requests can be completed. Rejected, cancelled and picked_up requests are terminal (409). Completion rechecks the reservation and the basket's expiry. No verification is required.

get.description: Fictional shops for sandbox tests, not real foodsharing cooperation partners. Requires a team key, no verification.

post.summary: Rescue food from a business (verified users only)
post.description: Records a completed business rescue for the selected team user (X-User-ID or key default). Requires is_verified=true, checked again under a user row lock. Unverified users in any onboarding stage receive 403. No request body needed. Each successful POST records one event and increments the regular pickup counter; repeated POSTs represent separate rescues. This sandbox does not model appointment slots or shop stock. The event appears in GET /users/me/pickups with source=business and was_trial=false.

VerificationUpdateRequest.title: VerificationUpdateRequest
VerificationUpdateRequest.description:
Editable verification progress, without changing actual pickup events.

Counter edits do not create/delete pickup events. Explicit is_verified wins over
automatic derivation for this PATCH. Later PATCHes supplying quiz, approval or
trial counter inputs recalculate it, even if those values are unchanged.
